card.name: Words just before bleeding or hemorrhage
card.fires_on: The word right before an expected 'bleeding' or 'hemorrhage', or partway through the word hemorrhage. It is strongest where a verb such as control or stop leads into bleeding.

modes.label: Verb before bleeding
modes.description: An action word like control, stop, or apply pressure that leads straight into bleeding or hemostasis.

modes.label: Partway through hemorrhage phrases
modes.description: Inside postpartum or hemorrhage-type words, where the next word is hemorrhage or bleeding.

modes.description: An adjective or linking word that sits between a risk phrase and bleeding.

card.writes: It pushes the model to write bleed, bleeding, or hemorrhage as the next word.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say 'bleeding' or 'hemorrhage'.
